title: Mourning all the the future Madeleines and Helen’s who would have bee...
transcript: In a bit of sad news today, we just got noticed that Death Becomes Her is going to be closing on Broadway June 28th. Of course, as with any closing notice, my heart goes out to all of the cast and crew, but also my heart goes out to, like, the potential of what this could have been in terms of casting. It feels like there is so much potential here for some really fun stunt casting, and I'm. I'm a little sad that they didn't dive into that before announcing a closing notice. But I definitely wonder, with this closing at the beginning of summer and the North American tour launching September 12th, if they aren't also just closing this so that they can use the set on the tour. This is one of my favourite recent movie to musical adaptations. It's a lot of fun. Definitely, if you can go see it before June 28th, I highly recommend it and I cannot wait to see how this tours. I think this is gonna be a really fun tour. And they also think this could be a really, really, really fun show that we see in regional theatres across the country. I do think Death Becomes Her has the potential to be the kind of legally blonde esque staple in regional and community theatres across the nation. I'm just sad that that era is gonna start a little sooner than we all expected.
classificationReason: Video is framed around the Broadway closing announcement (June 28th) and tour speculation, not a post-attendance review. Creator briefly recommends going before closing but the primary purpose is reacting to the news.
